kind.x-source: PT-007 requires a channel-neutral COMMAND and RESULT pair.

channel.x-source: PT-007 Inputs: 'in-app first; email/LINE future'. Listing the two future channels is a DECLARED INFERENCE -- PT-007 names them as future, so a contract that omitted them would have to change to add them.

message_key.x-source: PT-007 requires locale support, and CTR-ERR-001 establishes a Thai message KEY rather than prose for user-facing text. DECLARED INFERENCE from that precedent.

locale.x-source: Section 3.1: Phase 1 locale default is th-TH. Only the supported locale is listed, so adding one is a visible contract change.

deep_link.x-source: PT-007 requires deep-link support, and CTR-NTF-001's own catalog row requires a 'permission-checked deep link'. requires_permission is const true because a deep link that does not demand a permission check is the defect the row names. The target_ref grammar is the catalog reference form adopted from CTR-IDM-001.

dedupe_key.x-source: ID-005 notification dedupe strategy: a completed or retried event must not notify a user twice beyond policy. PT-007 requires dedupe support.

delivery.x-source: PT-007 acceptance: 'delivery failure does not roll back domain result'. domain_result_rolled_back is const false so the prohibition is expressed in the contract rather than described in prose. CT-007 requires transient and permanent failure to be distinguishable.

tenant_context.x-source: Section 3.1: every command touching customer data carries the Trusted Tenant Context.

allOf.x-rule: PT-007: a channel-neutral COMMAND names its channel, its localized message key and its permission-checked deep link, and carries no delivery state -- that belongs to the result.

PT-007: a delivery failure must not roll back the domain result, and CT-007 requires transient and permanent failure to be distinguishable. A failure that states neither is unusable to a retry policy.
